units.title: When rookies win
units.blurb: Big wins and why they are not templates.

lessons.title: AnytimeAnnie36 (Degen, TD Scorer Stacker)
lessons.rule: AnytimeAnnie36 turned $100 into $979.57 in 2024 with anytime_td:yes x4 at 328x (paid $901.64). Their strategy overall returned -19.5%: a big win is not a template.

caveat: Every study replays the same real NFL seasons, so extra studies average out the betters' randomness, not what really happened. A lesson taught on two seasons can fail on a third: that is what releases are for. Lessons are priors for MY BOO, JIMMY and JEV, not guarantees.
